verdict.rationale: Crossmint documents headless, non-browser operation through REST APIs with server-side API keys, and agent wallets that transact with no user prompt per action, so headless automation is directly supported. CI-specific use is not documented, and agent checkouts have no staging environment, which limits automated testing. Missing for 10: a CLI or CI-specific guidance, test or sandbox environments for all agent products, and independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI pipelines.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Crossmint's headless checkout API is a set of REST APIs that allow you to integrate credit card and cross-chain crypto payments inside your app with full control of the user experience.
The headless checkout supports both server-side and client-side API keys.
You want to use Crossmint checkout outside of a browser environment
